entries.2e6fc55b917bb3b5: It has a vertically integrated service delivery system in which the group holds and operates everything from infrastructure to applications on a consistent basis. In addition, it has obtained multiple security certifications, including full compliance certification under PCIDSS Ver.4.0.1 for its payment agency service.
entries.479cc89be4b254a9: In the cloud services industry, the movement to promote corporate digital transformation (DX) continues, and corporate investment appetite toward implementing generative AI and AI agents has risen further. Of its revenue of ¥2,661 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, cloud integration services accounted for ¥1,833 million.
